title: [test] compose-up smoke test of the README quickstart
description:
Prove the documented path actually works.

Files: scripts/smoke_compose.sh.

Acceptance criteria:
- Script runs 'docker compose up -d', waits for the healthcheck to report healthy.
- Executes the README curl examples: shorten a URL, follow the code, read /stats.
- Asserts expected status codes (201/307/200) and exits non-zero on any mismatch.
- Tears down with 'docker compose down -v' in all cases, including failure.

title: [impl] Document all endpoints and env vars in README with curl examples
description:
Bring the README up to shipping quality.

Files: README.md.

Behaviour: document POST /shorten, GET /{code}, GET /stats/{code}, GET /health,
each with a copy-pasteable curl example and sample response, plus both
environment variables (SNIPURL_DB, SNIPURL_RATE_LIMIT) with defaults, and the
docker compose quickstart.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every endpoint has a working curl example and a sample response body.
- SNIPURL_DB and SNIPURL_RATE_LIMIT are documented with defaults and effect.
- A reader can go from git clone to a working short link using only the README.

title: [impl] Add Dockerfile and docker-compose with healthcheck and DB volume
description:
Make the service runnable from a fresh clone.

Files: Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .dockerignore.

Behaviour: the image installs the project and runs uvicorn on port 8080.
Compose publishes 8080, sets SNIPURL_DB to a path inside a named volume so links
survive a container restart, and defines a healthcheck hitting GET /health.

Acceptance criteria:
- 'docker compose up' serves GET /health on http://localhost:8080/health.
- The container reports healthy via the compose healthcheck.
- A code created before 'docker compose restart' still resolves after it (volume persists).
- .dockerignore excludes .git, tests, and local *.db files.

title: [test] end-to-end journey plus 429 under sustained load, over HTTP
description:
Full-service verification against the running instance.

Files: tests/integration/test_e2e.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- Covers create code -> follow redirect -> read /stats -> confirm the click count moved.
- Covers sustained POST /shorten producing a 429 with Retry-After.
- All requests go over HTTP to the harness base URL.
- ./scripts/run_integration.sh exits 0 on success and non-zero on any failure.

title: [impl] Add live-server integration harness and run script
description:
Build the harness the end-to-end suite runs against.

Files: tests/integration/conftest.py, scripts/run_integration.sh.

Behaviour: a session fixture starts uvicorn as a real subprocess on a free port
with SNIPURL_DB pointed at a temp file, waits for GET /health to answer, yields
the base URL, then terminates the process and deletes the DB file. The script
runs the suite with one command and propagates the pytest exit code.

Acceptance criteria:
- Tests talk HTTP to a real server process, not the in-process TestClient.
- Health polling has a bounded timeout and fails loudly if the server never comes up.
- The temp DB file is removed on teardown, pass or fail.
- ./scripts/run_integration.sh runs the suite and exits non-zero on failure.

title: [test] click counter increments per redirect and stats reads are side-effect free
description:
Verify analytics.

Files: tests/test_stats.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- Creates a code, asserts clicks == 0, redirects twice, asserts clicks == 2.
- Calls /stats twice and asserts the count did not change.
- Asserts 404 for an unknown code.
- 'pytest' passes, exiting 0.

title: [impl] Count redirects and add GET /stats/{code}
description:
Report per-code usage.

Files: app/main.py, app/db.py.

Behaviour: each successful redirect increments that code's clicks counter.
GET /stats/{code} returns {"code", "url", "clicks", "created_at"}.
Unknown code returns 404. Reading stats does not increment the counter.

Acceptance criteria:
- One redirect increments clicks by exactly one.
- GET /stats/{code} returns all four fields with correct values.
- Unknown code on /stats -> 404 with a JSON body.
- Repeated /stats calls leave clicks unchanged.

title: [test] 429 on the 11th request and success after the window resets
description:
Verify throttling deterministically, without sleeping a real minute.

Files: tests/test_ratelimit.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- Sets a small SNIPURL_RATE_LIMIT (or monkeypatches the clock) so the test runs in under a second.
- Asserts the first N requests succeed and the N+1th returns 429 with Retry-After.
- Asserts a request after the window advances succeeds again.
- Asserts GET /{code} still works while POST is throttled.
- 'pytest' passes, exiting 0.

title: [impl] Rate-limit POST /shorten to 10 req/min per client IP
description:
Add per-IP throttling to code creation only.

Files: app/ratelimit.py, app/main.py.

Behaviour: a fixed- or sliding-window counter keyed by client IP limits
POST /shorten to SNIPURL_RATE_LIMIT requests per minute (default 10). Over the
limit returns 429 with a Retry-After header. GET /{code} is never rate limited.

Acceptance criteria:
- 11th POST /shorten inside one window returns 429 with Retry-After set.
- Requests are counted per client IP, not globally.
- GET /{code} is unaffected regardless of how many requests were made.
- SNIPURL_RATE_LIMIT env var changes the threshold.

title: [test] links survive restart and the DB file is isolated per test
description:
Verify persistence.

Files: tests/test_persistence.py, tests/conftest.py (SNIPURL_DB tmp_path fixture).

Acceptance criteria:
- A fixture points SNIPURL_DB at a tmp_path file; the developer's ./snipurl.db is never touched.
- Test creates a code, rebuilds the app/connection against the same file, and asserts the code still resolves.
- Test asserts a schema-level IntegrityError (or the idempotent-code path) for a duplicate url.
- 'pytest' passes, exiting 0.

title: [impl] Wire /shorten and /{code} to the SQLite store
description:
Replace in-memory storage with the SQLite store.

Files: app/main.py, app/shortener.py.

Behaviour: both endpoints read and write through app/db.py. No in-memory dict
remains as the source of truth. Idempotency of POST /shorten is now backed by
the UNIQUE url constraint.

Acceptance criteria:
- No module-level dict is used to store links anymore.
- All existing tests still pass, using a temporary database file via SNIPURL_DB.
- A code created, then the app re-instantiated against the same DB file, still resolves.

title: [impl] Add SQLite storage module with auto-created schema
description:
Introduce the persistence layer.

Files: app/db.py, app/config.py (or settings section in app/config.py).

Behaviour: SQLite-backed store with a links table (code PK, url UNIQUE,
clicks INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at). The UNIQUE constraint on url is enforced
in the schema, not only in Python. Database path comes from the SNIPURL_DB
environment variable, defaulting to ./snipurl.db. Schema is created on first
startup with no manual migration step.

Acceptance criteria:
- Importing and initialising the module creates the file and schema if absent.
- Insert/lookup helpers for code and url exist and are used by no one yet.
- Duplicate url insert raises a database integrity error (schema-level UNIQUE).
- SNIPURL_DB overrides the path; default is ./snipurl.db.

title: [test] redirect status, Location header, and both 404 paths
description:
Verify the redirect route.

Files: tests/test_redirect.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- Creates a code via POST /shorten, then asserts GET /{code} is 307 with the
  expected Location (client configured not to follow redirects).
- Asserts 404 + JSON body for an unknown but well-formed code.
- Asserts 404 (not 500) for an invalid-shape code.
- 'pytest' passes, exiting 0.

title: [impl] Add GET /{code} redirect with JSON 404 handling
description:
Resolve a short code back to its target URL.

Files: app/main.py (route), app/shortener.py (lookup helper).

Behaviour: GET /{code} returns 307 with a Location header set to the original
URL. Unknown code returns 404 with a JSON error body (never HTML). A code of
the wrong length or with invalid characters returns 404, not 500.

Acceptance criteria:
- Known code -> 307 and correct Location header, no redirect following in the handler.
- Unknown code -> 404 and a JSON body such as {"detail": "..."}.
- Bad-shape code (wrong length / invalid chars) -> 404, never a 500.

title: [test] POST /shorten happy path, idempotency, and 422 rejections
description:
Cover code creation end to end at the API level.

Files: tests/test_shorten.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- Asserts 201, code length 7, URL-safe charset, and short_url ends with the code.
- Asserts posting the same URL twice returns an identical code.
- Asserts 422 for a malformed URL and 422 for a non-http(s) scheme (e.g. ftp://).
- 'pytest' passes, exiting 0.

title: [impl] Add POST /shorten endpoint with code generation and URL validation
description:
Implement short-code creation.

Files: app/main.py (route), app/shortener.py (code generation + validation).

Behaviour: POST /shorten accepts JSON {"url": "<long-url>"} and returns 201
with {"code": "<code>", "short_url": "<base>/<code>"}. Codes are 7
URL-safe characters and unique. Submitting the same long URL twice returns the
same code (idempotent). Storage may be an in-memory map at this stage; it is
replaced by SQLite in a later task. Base URL comes from a SNIPURL_BASE_URL
setting with a localhost:8080 default.

Acceptance criteria:
- Happy path returns 201 with a 7-char URL-safe code and a matching short_url.
- Same URL posted twice yields the same code.
- Malformed URL or non-http(s) scheme returns 422 with an explanatory message.

title: [EPIC] snipurl: a URL shortener service
description:
Build a small, well-tested URL shortener service.

This epic is the sprint root. Its children are the deliverable scope; no work beyond them is in scope.

## Definition of done

- All child issues closed with passing tests.
- 'docker compose up' brings the service up on port 8080.
- The integration test playbook passes end to end against the running service.

## Non-goals

- User accounts, authentication, or a web UI.
- Custom domains or vanity codes.
- Any persistence backend other than SQLite.

title: Dockerfile, compose, and README
description:
Make the service runnable by someone who has just cloned it.

## Acceptance criteria

- A Dockerfile builds the service into a runnable image.
- `docker compose up` starts it on port 8080 with a persistent volume for the
  SQLite file.
- The container passes a healthcheck against `GET /health`.
- The README documents every endpoint with a working `curl` example, plus both
  environment variables.
- A fresh clone can go from `git clone` to a working short link using only the
  README.

## Depends on

Integration test suite.

title: Integration test suite
description:
Verify the whole service end to end against a running instance.

## Acceptance criteria

- Tests run against a live server over HTTP, not the in-process test client.
- Covers the full journey: create a code, follow it, read its stats, confirm the
  click count moved.
- Covers the rate limit returning 429 under sustained requests.
- The suite is runnable with a single command and exits non-zero on failure.
- The suite cleans up its database file afterwards.

## Depends on

Click analytics endpoint and rate limiting.

title: Click analytics endpoint
description:
Report how often each code has been used.

## Acceptance criteria

- Each successful redirect increments a click counter for that code.
- `GET /stats/{code}` returns `{"code", "url", "clicks", "created_at"}`.
- Requesting stats for an unknown code returns HTTP 404.
- Fetching stats does not itself increment the counter.
- Tests assert the counter increments once per redirect and that the stats call
  leaves it unchanged.

## Depends on

Persist links in SQLite.

title: Rate-limit code creation by IP
description:
Stop a single client from exhausting the code space.

## Acceptance criteria

- `POST /shorten` is limited to 10 requests per minute per client IP.
- Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header.
- `GET /{code}` is not rate limited.
- The limit is configurable via a `SNIPURL_RATE_LIMIT` environment variable.
- Tests assert that the 11th request within a window is rejected and that a
  request after the window succeeds.

## Depends on

Persist links in SQLite.

title: Persist links in SQLite
description:
Make shortened links survive a restart.

## Acceptance criteria

- Links are stored in SQLite; the database path is configurable via a
  `SNIPURL_DB` environment variable and defaults to `./snipurl.db`.
- A code created before a restart still resolves after it.
- Schema is created automatically on first startup; no manual migration step.
- The unique constraint on the long URL is enforced at the database level, not
  only in application code.
- Tests use a temporary database file and do not touch the developer's real one.

## Depends on

POST /shorten and GET /{code}.

title: GET /{code} - redirect with 404 handling
description:
Resolve a short code back to its target.

## Acceptance criteria

- `GET /{code}` returns HTTP 307 with a `Location` header set to the original
  URL.
- An unknown code returns HTTP 404 with a JSON error body, not an HTML page.
- A code that is the wrong length or contains invalid characters returns 404
  rather than 500.
- Tests assert the redirect status and `Location` header, and cover both 404
  paths.

## Depends on

POST /shorten.

title: POST /shorten - create a short code
description:
Accept a long URL and return a short code for it.

## Acceptance criteria

- `POST /shorten` accepts JSON `{"url": "<long-url>"}`.
- Returns HTTP 201 with `{"code": "<code>", "short_url": "<base>/<code>"}`.
- Codes are 7 characters, URL-safe, and unique across requests.
- Submitting the same long URL twice returns the same code (idempotent).
- A malformed or non-http(s) URL returns HTTP 422 with an explanatory message.
- Tests cover: happy path, idempotency, and both rejection cases.

## Depends on

Project scaffold and health endpoint.
